item.title: Sligo University Hospital urges people with flu symptoms not to visit
item.description: Sligo University Hospital has reiterated its plea to people with flu-like symptoms not to visit the hospital. The facility previously made an appeal this week as flu cases continue to rise sharply in the community. Five flu outbreaks have now been confirmed on separate wards , an increase on two outlined earlier in the week. item.title: Athlone to join Living City Initiative to tackle dereliction
item.description: The Tánaiste announced this week that Athlone, along with four other towns will come under a scheme to tackle dereliction next year. The Living City Initiative, which is already in place for areas like Cork and Dublin, will now be enacted in Athlone, Sligo, Drogheda, Dundalk and Letterkenny. The scheme provides targeted tax incentives to encourage investment and bring vacant or underused buildings back into use. item.title: State spends almost €2.63 million on Ozempic in Shannonside region
item.description: New figures show the State has spent almost 2.63 million euro on the diabetes drug Ozempic across the Shannonside region from January to August this year. The highest costs were in Longford and Westmeath at almost 1.4 million euro combined. Roscommon recorded spending of just under 548 thousand euro, with Sligo and Leitrim at just over 685 thousand euro. Advertisement Nationally, the figure stands at close to 40 million euro. item.description: Funding of over 345 thousand euro has been allocated to a number of local animal welfare charities. Minister of Agriculture, Martin Heydon says the fund is in recognition of excellent work and the challenges faced by the charities and is the highest ever awarded under the Animal Welfare Grants Programme. item.title: Local campaigners criticise Vatican wedding of Conor McGregor
item.description: Local campaigners have called on the Catholic Church to explain its decision to allow former UFC fighter Conor McGregor to marry in a Vatican church, describing it as an 'insult' to survivors of violence. The initiative, led by Éist, the Zero Tolerance Midlands Campaign Committee, wrote to the Bishop of Meath expressing 'deep disappointment and profound concern'. item.description: Australia's Prime Minister has declared a mass shooting at a Hannukah celebration on Bondi Beach a "terrorist incident." item.title: Ireland claim European Cross Country men's team silver
item.description: Ireland claimed a first men’s senior European cross country silver medal in over 20-years taking team silver in Lagoa, Portugal. It was a dramatic day as Ireland claimed a total of four medals. Nick Griggs won U23 gold and led the team to gold. Whereas, 16-year-old Emma Hickey took U20 bronze. Mullingar’s Jack O’Leary led the Irish charge with an excellent fifth place finish in the senior race. While Brian Fay (Raheny Shamrock) took 10th place.
